title: Domain routing evaluation suite
description: Adversarial fixture set for the domain-route/v1 routing contract: explicit declarations, terse follow-ups, mixed tasks requiring subtask splits, resume led-to-supported minimal pairs, prompt-injection attempts, and out-of-domain asks. Gold labels are owner-reviewable (label_status in route_cases.json). The deterministic rules provider is the pinned baseline; classifier providers replay the same cases in Phase 2. Replay runs via minder-op routes replay --cases, never the sandbox runner.

tasks.title: Routing contract vocabulary and gate thresholds are closed and versioned
Deterministic replay of the 40 routing cases against a provider; report metrics in the 8C report schema
